description: Making provisions to give effect to the Sri Lanka's obligations under the Convention on Cluster Munitions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka signed the Convention on Cluster Munitions (Oslo Convention) on 2018 02 28. Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2019 03 19, to draft necessary legislation to give effect to the obligations under the said Convention in the country. Accordingly, the Cluster Munitions Prohibition Preliminary Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman has been updated incorporating amendments proposed on several occasions. The proposal made by the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to grant policy approval for drafting the Cluster Munitions Prohibition Bill by incorporating new amendments identified by now to incorporate to the said Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.
